era: Etsy desktop 2019 as served to US visitors (Arquivo.pt captures of the home page Mar, Jul and Nov 2019, search result pages Jul, Nov and Dec 2019, listing pages Jul, Sep and Dec 2019): white header with the orange Etsy logo, a wide rounded 'Search for items or shops' field with a search button, Sell on Etsy / Sign in / Cart, a category bar (Jewelry & Accessories ... Vintage, Gifts), home hero with category circles and 'Popular right now', 'What is Etsy?' and 'Recent reviews from happy people'; search results with 'All categories', result count, 'Sort by: Relevancy' and square photo cards; listing pages with the photo carousel, price, 'Add to cart', 'Add to Favorites', 'Item details', 'Reviews', 'Photos from reviews', 'Meet the owner', more items from the shop and 'You may also like'; footer with Shop / Sell / About / Help, 'Download the Etsy App' and 'United States | English (US) | $ (USD)'. The live site is behind DataDome bot protection, so the inventory was taken read-only in the user's signed-out Chrome with the inventory collector.
